subject: general
question:
A question is given, followed by three statements labelled I, II and III. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.

Question:

How is P related to C?

Statements:

I: H is the only brother of S and P.

II: P is the wife of L, who is the son-in-law of D.

III: D is the mother of S and T is the son-in-law of C.

options.text: Data in statements I, II and III together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statements II and III together are sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statements I, II and III together are sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question
